name: smile-to-whisper-cinematic
image_purpose: Short-form lifestyle video and conversational storytelling

prompt.project_info: Create a four-cut conversational sequence showing an approved adult woman's charm through a smile, tactile hand detail, whisper close-up, and lingering pull-back.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with light brown hair and bangs, wearing a modest cream sweatshirt, white headphones, silver chain, loose blue jeans, and carrying a white handbag. Her expressions progress naturally from warm smile to playful whisper and laugh.
prompt.composition_elements: Four connected cuts: medium conversation shot with a friend, close-up of hands on the handbag clasp, intimate whisper close-up, and a wider pull-back showing the relaxed industrial interior. Maintain wardrobe, bag, headphones, and friend continuity.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft directional indoor light, natural concrete textures, gentle highlights, intimate friend-to-friend energy, restrained film grain, and immersive binaural-style sound cues.
prompt.technical_specs: Cinematic short-form sequence, 4 cuts, medium and close-up coverage, smooth pull-back, realistic audio-oriented gestures, natural color and texture, no readable branding.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic four-cut lifestyle sequence featuring one approved adult woman with light brown hair and bangs, wearing a modest cream sweatshirt, white headphones, silver chain, loose blue jeans, and carrying a white handbag. Cut one shows a warm smile while speaking with a friend, cut two shows hands resting on the handbag clasp, cut three moves into a playful whisper close-up, and cut four lingers in a wider pull-back as she laughs in a relaxed industrial interior. Soft directional light, natural concrete texture, subtle film grain, smooth continuity, immersive conversational mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, inconsistent wardrobe, changed bag, random text, watermark, random logos, celebrity likeness, low resolution, blur

assets.name: smile-to-whisper-cinematic.jpg
assets.usage: Use for four-cut structure, approved adult styling, headphones, handbag, industrial setting, and cinematic mood.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve continuity of the approved adult subject, outfit, bag, headphones, friend interaction, four-cut progression, and environment. The reference is replaceable with another approved adult conversation scene while retaining the same emotional sequence. Explicitly define replacement identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, or typography; do not invent them.
